504050.name: Šoporňa
504050.note: No okrsky document for the municipal elections of 10 November 2018 was found: the old site's news list (archived 2018-08-20) and Voľby page (archived 2018-10-10, 2018-11-13) show only the number of deputies/obvod notice, population count, harmonogram, delegation notice and voter information (all checked, scanned); the harmonogram says the okrsky were to be set by 11.09.2018 but no such document was archived or is live. The Internet Archive was online.

504068.name: Tešedíkovo
504068.note: The archived Komunálne voľby 2018 pages (Slovak 2018-08-22, Hungarian 2018-10-07) list no okrsky document (only the council's obvod notice, resolutions 38–39/OZ/2018, voter-roll, candidate and delegation notices); no PDF of the site before 2021 is archived. Every okrsky document Tešedíkovo published (referendum 2023, NR SR 2023, president 2024, EP 2024, referendum 2026, municipal/regional 2026) gives each of its 3 okrsky only its polling station (Dom kultúry č. 860; MŠ č. 153; Školská jedáleň ZŠ č. 974), never which houses vote where. The municipality has one part and no streets in the register, so the okrsky cannot be placed or inferred from the stations (the prompt's part-inference needs as many parts as okrsky).

504092.name: Trnovec nad Váhom
504092.note: The archived 2018 municipal-elections page (2018-07-30) has no okrsky document; the second 2018 page (p/2219) is not retrievable from the Internet Archive (404). The current website has no pages before 2022. The Internet Archive answered mostly HTTP 429/connection refused; retried with pauses.

504106.name: Trstice
504106.note: No okrsky document for the municipal elections of 10 November 2018 on trstice.sk. The 2018 notice-board items are the generic voter information (item 72), the announcement of one volebný obvod with 11 seats (item 74, 24.7.2018), the population count, the recorder's appointment, candidate lists and results; no 'utvorenie volebných okrskov' was posted, and no radio announcement of the days before the vote is archived. Every item of the official notice board (úradná tabuľa, items 1–444, 2016–2026, incl. the items migrated from the old Joomla site) was listed by id and every election item opened; the Internet Archive (CDX of trstice.sk, old site trstice.sk/sk/aktuality/…) was searched for election pages and radio announcements (hlásenie miestneho rozhlasu) around the vote; the IA was slow and often refused connections, but the pages listed in tried were retrieved.

504114.name: Váhovce
504114.note: The municipality's old WordPress website (vahovce.sk) archived page "Voľby do orgánov samosprávy obcí" (2019) lists the 2018 election documents: the Zbierka decision calling the elections, the oznámenie on the volebný obvod and number of councillors, the e-mail addresses, the MVK recorder, candidate lists and results; no okrsky decision. The archived August–September 2018 PDFs retrieved contain no okrsky decision either. The current website obecvahovce.sk starts in 2022. Internet Archive was slow/intermittent (HTTP 503/timeouts) but answered after retries.

504122.name: Veľká Mača
504122.note: Veľká Mača's okrsky documents (2023 NRSR, 2024 president, 2024 EP, 2026 municipal/regional) only create 2 okrsky and name their polling stations, both in the same building (Obecný úrad, Sereďská 137: zasadačka / sobášna sieň); none assigns streets or house numbers. The municipality has one part and no street names, so the okrsky cannot be inferred from stations. No 2017–2022 documents are on the site and the Internet Archive has no captures of velkamaca.sk for 2017–2022.

504131.name: Veľké Úľany
504131.note: The municipality's okrsky notices (2024 presidential, 2026) give only the four polling stations, all in the same part (Veľké Úľany, Hlavná 579/8 and 578/9), with no streets or parts per okrsok; no document with streets is on the website, and the Internet Archive keeps only the old frames site (no election documents for 2017–2023).

504271.name: Brodské
504271.note: The website's election archive has no page or document of the 2018 municipal elections. The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

504351.name: Gbely
504351.note: No document setting the okrsky for the municipal elections of 10 November 2018 was found. The city's current website (CMS since 2020) keeps elections documents only from 2022 on; the older WordPress site (2017–2019) is gone. In the Internet Archive (reachable but intermittently refusing connections / 429), the notice board gbely.sk/uradna-tabula/ has captures only up to 2018-09-26 and none in autumn 2017 or 2019–2020; the 2018-09-26 capture lists the 2018 municipal-election notices (kandidáti, volebné obvody, MVK) but no okrsky document, and no archived file of the old site concerns okrsky. Moreover every okrsky document Gbely published later (2022–2026) gives only the polling station of each okrsok, all in ZŠ s MŠ Pionierska 697, which cannot be turned into rules.

504416.name: Jablonica
504416.note: The 2018 elections page lists no okrsky document (only the vote's announcement, voter information, the MVK clerk and candidate lists). The okrsky documents of this municipality (2015/16, 2022, 2024) define the two okrsky by street names (okrsok 1: Červenej armády, Dúbrava, Hurbanova, …; okrsok 2: Bernolákova, Bosý Jarok, Brezie, …), but the address register has no streets for Jablonica (all 946 addresses are without a street, one part, one k.ú.), so no rule can select those streets and the document cannot be turned into valid rules without guessing.

504513.name: Kúty
504513.note: Kúty had 2 okrsky then; no document setting them (streets per okrsok) found on kuty.sk live or in the Internet Archive (CDX of the whole domain checked). The archived old site only has the post 'Volebné miestnosti' (11 March 2019): 'V obci Kúty boli vytvorené dva volebné okrsky', both in the cultural house, without streets.

504742.name: Radošovce
504742.note: No okrsky document of the municipal elections of 10 November 2018 is available. The current website (radosovce.sk, rebuilt 2023) keeps only documents from 2023 on; the old site's static mirror radosovce.obecnyarchiv.sk has no 2018 election page (its 'volby-2022' page was reused for the 2023 referendum). The old site's elections page of 2018 (www.radosovce.sk/obec/volby/, linked from the homepage captured 2018-08-11 and 2018-09-04) was never captured by the Internet Archive, and no 2018 election PDF is in its CDX index. Later documents (2023–2026) give 2 okrsky: Radošovce súp. č. 1–316; Vieska súp. č. 1–202 and Radošovce súp. č. 317–475.

504769.name: Rohožník
504769.note: No document of this vote assigning addresses to okrsky found live or in the Internet Archive. The only Rohožník document with an address split is the 2024 presidential one (súpisné čísla 1–381 / 382–395 / 396–800, dated 24.1.2024); other okrsky documents on the site (e.g. the NR SR 2020 / 2026 'Určenie volebných okrskov') list only the polling station (all three in the same school), so they cannot place addresses.

504947.name: Veľké Leváre
504947.note: The 2018 municipal elections page lists only the results; the live notice board has no okrsky entry for 2018. The old website (levare.sk/index.php?ID=…, files /data/files/N.pdf) used until 2019 is only partly archived; the archived PDFs of 2015–2018 (data/files 843–955, 1036, 1052) contain no okrsky document. The Internet Archive was intermittently offline/very slow during the search.

505374.name: Prašice
505374.note: The 2018 homepage (archived 24 Aug and 25 Sep 2018) lists the municipal election documents /docs/2018/volby01–07.pdf (information, decision, population, recorder, candidate lists, 'Oznámenie o určení počtu poslancov a o utvorení volebných obvodov', delegation); none is an okrsky document and none was archived. No okrsky document of 2018 found live, in archiv.prasice.sk or the Internet Archive. The Internet Archive was intermittently offline during the search; it was retried until it answered.

505421.name: Radošina
505421.note: No document of the 2018 okrsky found. The old website (now archiv.radosina.sk) keeps no 2018 elections item: its notice board starts in 2023, its 2018 news (e.g. the request for the portable ballot box, 6.11.2018) do not list okrsky, and the local newspaper of 2018 gives only the results (3 okrsky). The Internet Archive's 2018–2022 captures of radosina.sk (pages, fileadmin files, news details) contain no okrsky notice for 2018; the 2020 notice for the National Council election is another vote's. The present website (new CMS) has no 2018 documents. The Internet Archive was intermittently offline (503 / connection refused) but its CDX answered on retries.

505498.name: Solčany
505498.note: The live website obecsolcany.sk shows elections pages only from 2022 on. In the Internet Archive (offline about 15 minutes, then answered) the archived pages of 2017 (Voľby do VÚC 2017), 2018 (komunálne voľby 2018) and 2019 (EP 2019) list no okrsky document; the 2017 'Delegovanie člena okrskovej komisie a Zoznam volebných miestností' (download_file_f.php?id=879674) has only the delegation notice, no okrsky; the 2019 presidential page could not be loaded and no page of the 2020 National Council election is archived. The municipality's later okrsky documents name only the polling stations, no streets.

505714.name: Veľké Ripňany
505714.note: No document of the 2018 okrsky found. The municipality's 2018 elections page (archived 2019-07-21) gives only the two obvody (resolution 3/2018), the candidates and the results; the archived 2018 notice board has no elections item; the other 2018 files the Internet Archive kept are unrelated (waste leaflets); the present website (new CMS) has no 2018 documents. Web searches found nothing.

505722.name: Veľké Uherce
505722.note: The 2018 document "Vytvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností" (7.9.2018) names only the two polling stations (both in the obecný úrad, Veľké Uherce 360), not which houses vote in each okrsok; the municipality has a single part, so the okrsky cannot be inferred from the stations.

505731.name: Veľký Klíž
505731.note: The 2018 elections entry of the notice board (posted 23. 8. 2018) holds the council's notice on the number of deputies and the single volebný obvod, the recorder's appointment, candidate lists and the e-mail for delegating commission members, but no notice on the okrsky and polling stations; no other 2018 page or archived capture of the website has one.

505943.name: Dolná Súča
505943.note: No okrsky document of this vote found on the website (notice board and site search); the only one found, for the 2026 referendum, does not define the okrsky's territory. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

505960.name: Drietoma
505960.note: Drietoma (one part, no streets) publishes for its votes only the number of okrsky and their common polling station (prístavba kultúrneho domu súp. č. 321), e.g. "Volebné okrsky a zapisovateľky" (referendum 2023); no document says which houses vote in which okrsok, so no rules can be written. For 2018 the website keeps no election pages.

506010.name: Horná Súča
506010.note: No okrsky document of this vote on the website (its elections section starts in 2022). The municipality's okrsky documents (referendum 2023 of 09.11.2022, NR SR 2023, prezident 2024, referendum 2026 of 06.05.2026) give each of the 6 okrsky only its polling station (1 knižnica č. 233 and 2 MŠ č. 235 both in Horná Súča, 3 Dúbrava, 4 Závrská, 5 Vlčí Vrch, 6 Trnávka); the municipality has 7 parts (Dolná/Horná Závrská, Krásny Dub, ...) and two okrsky lie in part Horná Súča, so the okrsky cannot be given by the parts of their stations, and no document says which addresses vote where.

506036.name: Horné Srnie
506036.note: The archived 2018 elections category page (old site) lists no okrsky document.

506125.name: Kočovce
506125.note: The archived 2018 elections page (captured 13.11.2018) lists the obvody announcement, the voters' information, the clerk's appointment, the candidate lists, poster areas and the results, but no okrsky document; the archived notice board of August–November 2018 has none either, and the live site keeps only current notices. The obvody announcement (one obvod per part: Kočovce, Beckovská Vieska, Rakoľuby) does not mention okrsky, and the results record (3 obvody, 3 okrsky) does not say which okrsok is which, so the numbering of the okrsky is not documented.

506141.name: Kostolné
506141.note: The 2018 municipal elections subsection holds only the results (estranky and kostolne.sk). The 2023 documents split okrsok 1 = Kostolné and okrsok 2 = Babulicov Vrch with the hamlets.

506150.name: Krajné

No okrsky document for 2017–2020 or the 2026 referendum is on the website.

506265.name: Moravské Lieskové
506265.note: No okrsky notice for this vote: the website's elections documents start with the NR SR elections 2023; the Internet Archive keeps of 2017–2022 only notices of e-mail addresses and results (the 2018 and 2019 notices could not be retrieved or hold no okrsky). Another vote's notice is not this vote's.

506273.name: Motešice
506273.note: The archived 2018 municipal elections post (2018-08-30) links only candidacy information, voting-rights information and the delegation e-mail address; no okrsky document of 2018 is archived or live.

506427.name: Podolie
506427.note: No okrsky document of this vote on the website (notice board archive and site search). The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

506508.name: Soblahov
506508.note: Soblahov has no streets and one part (804 addresses by súpisné číslo). Its elections pages (2017-2026) hold no okrsky document with addresses; the one it publishes ("Utvorenie volebných okrskov s vymedzením ich územného obvodu", 2022) says only that 2 okrsky are formed, both voting in the Obecný úrad Soblahov 470, without saying which houses belong to which; so no rules can be written.

506567.name: Trenčianska Turná
506567.note: The current website (new CMS since 2022) has elections pages only from 2022 on. The old website's 2018 pages are only in the Internet Archive, and its CDX index of trencianskaturna.sk (2017-2026, every URL) lists no okrsky document before the one of 2022 (uploaded/volby/volebne-okrsky-a-volebne-miestnosti.pdf, captured 2022-08-04): no PDF or page under uploaded/volby, aktuality or uradna-tabula of 2018 with okrsky. The archived 2018 news page (oznámenie k voľbám 2018) names the recorder of the local election commission and the deadline for candidate lists, and links only a schedule (harmonogram); no okrsky. The Internet Archive was intermittently offline (connection refused) during the search.

506818.name: Boleráz
506818.note: The live notice board (current and archive records, searched for okrsk/volieb/miestnost) keeps election records only from 2022 on, besides result notices of 2018-2020; no okrsky document of this vote. The Internet Archive (offline at times, retried) has no capture of boleraz.sk before 2021.

506842.name: Brestovany
506842.note: No okrsky document for this vote: brestovany.sk keeps elections pages only from 2022 on (Komunálne voľby 2022 page is empty), and the Internet Archive holds no capture of brestovany.sk before 2022 (CDX 2017-2023). The later documents (2022-2026) give only the two polling stations, both in one building, with no streets, so even a document of this vote would most likely not place addresses.

506851.name: Bučany
506851.note: The municipality's okrsky notices (live: referendum 2026, 12.5.2026; archived: presidential 2024, 19.1.2024; referendum 2023, 14.11.2022) name only the polling rooms of okrsok 1 and 2 (Kultúrny dom and Dom služieb, both on Námestie sv. Floriána), with no streets; Bučany has a single part, so the okrsky cannot be drawn. The archived pages of 2018, 2019, 2020 and EP 2024 have no okrsky document; the NR SR 2023 page could not be fetched from the Archive.

506877.name: Cífer
506877.note: The live page of the 2018 municipal elections lists results, candidates, forms and the time/place announcement but no okrsky decision; the Internet Archive has no 2018 capture of it nor any 2018 okrsky document.

506923.name: Dolná Krupá
506923.note: The website (search for okrsky/určenie/miestností, the 2023 and 2024 election news pages) has okrsky documents only for 2022, the 2024 presidential and EP elections and the 2026 votes; the NR SR 2023 news page names only 'dva volebné okrsky' in the cultural centre. No okrsky document of this vote. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

506991.name: Drahovce
506991.note: The archived 2018 elections section lists the announcement, voter information, delegation address, population, the obvod announcement (9 seats, one obvod) and candidate lists; no okrsky document.

507024.name: Dvorníky
507024.note: The 2018 election posts on dvorniky.sk (live, all posts and uploads of June–November 2018 via the WordPress API, and the Internet Archive capture of the homepage of 1 Sep 2018) contain the voter information, the declaration, the population count, the obvod/seats notice (one obvod, 9 seats), the MVK recorder and the candidate lists, but no okrsky decision. No 2018 okrsky document found.

507067.name: Horné Orešany
507067.note: No 2018 elections page or okrsky document on the website (the Internet Archive was offline during the search).

507121.name: Chtelnica
507121.note: The municipality's okrsky notices (referendum 2023, presidential and EP 2024, referendum 2026) only state "utváram volebný okrsok č. 1 a volebný okrsok č. 2" with one polling station (Základná škola, Námestie 1. mája 3) for both; they never say which streets vote where, and Chtelnica has one part, so no rules can be written. For this vote not even such a notice is on the notice board (archive of all notices checked).

507253.name: Leopoldov
507253.note: The 2018 municipal elections page (live and archived 2019-08-21) links the council's obvod resolution, candidate lists and notices, but no 'utvorenie volebných okrskov' for 2018; the CDX lists none. The Internet Archive was intermittently unreachable (connection refused) but answered after retries.

507288.name: Madunice
507288.note: No okrsky document found for this vote. The live elections page (Voľby a referendum) keeps only the 2026 notices (Referendum 04.07.2026, Spojené voľby 2026). Its capture of 2022-03-19 lists for 2017–2020 only candidate lists, voters' information, the decisions calling elections, the commission delegation and the results; no 'utvorenie volebných okrskov' or street list. The Internet Archive's CDX of madunice.sk (2017–2026) has no other election notice, and no capture of the page between 2022 and 2025 lists the 2022–2024 votes. The host (webygroup) was fetched sparingly because of its rate limit.

507342.name: Moravany nad Váhom
507342.note: Moravany nad Váhom's live notice board lists only current items; probing its board files (e_download.php obsah150-620) found an okrsky decision only for the NR SR election 2023 (and 2022, 2026 municipal); none for this vote. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline) during the search.

507555.name: Smolenice
507555.note: No okrsky document for this vote: the website's elections pages (and their Internet Archive captures, old and new site) list for it only voters' information, voting-card forms, e-mail notices and results.

507601.name: Špačince
507601.note: The municipality's elections pages hold only results and candidate lists (2018–2020) or link to the ministry's website (2023–2024); no okrsky document of any vote was found on the website, its notice archive, or in the Internet Archive (CDX returned nothing).

507636.name: Šúrovce
507636.note: The website's elections page and notice board (current and archive) hold only 2026 documents; no okrsky document of this vote found. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

507709.name: Veľké Kostoľany
507709.note: Every okrsky document of Veľké Kostoľany found (prezident 2024 of 29.01.2024, EP 2024 of 29.02.2024, referendum 2026, municipal 2026 of 14.07.2026) only names 2 okrsky with one polling station (sála kultúrneho domu) and does not say which streets or houses vote in which okrsok; no document of 2017-2023 found live. 507750.name: Vrbové
507750.note: The town's okrsky decisions before 2023 (Určenie volebných okrskov for 10 Nov 2018 and for the presidential election 2019; the 'hlásenie okrskov' for the 2023 referendum) give only each okrsok's polling station, no streets; the town has one part, so the okrsky cannot be drawn from them. 507768.name: Zavar
507768.note: Zavar's website of that time (old CMS) is archived only in part: the archived notice board pages (2017, 2019) and the 2019 election pages (prezident, Európsky parlament) link no okrsky document, and the archive's several hundred untitled download_file_f.php captures cannot be matched to one. The okrsky documents found are of 2022 and 2024 only.

507849.name: Budmerice
507849.note: The Webygroup website keeps no elections page; its notice board and announcements now list only items of late 2026, and the site search finds no okrsky document of this vote (only the 2026 municipal elections' minutes). 507857.name: Častá
507857.note: All the WordPress posts and the ~60 unnamed scanned PDFs of the media library from the weeks before this vote were checked (OCR of first pages); none is the okrsky decision. The Internet Archive (web.archive.org, incl. the CDX API) refused connections throughout (about 45 minutes, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

507890.name: Gajary
507890.note: Gajary publishes for each vote only "informácia o počte volebných okrskov a určení volebných miestností": 2 okrsky, both in the Obecný úrad, Hlavná 67/105 (right and left room), and per-voter notices ("Oznámenie o čase a mieste konania volieb", a template for one address); no document on the website or in the Internet Archive says which streets or houses vote in okrsok 1 or 2, so no rules can be written.

507911.name: Chorvátsky Grob
507911.note: The archived elections page (2018-11-08) links 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností' (download_file_f.php?id=1015820), but the PDF was never archived and the old site is gone (live 404).

507989.name: Svätý Jur
507989.note: The town's pages per vote exist for 2023 (NR SR), 2024 and 2026 (October); no okrsky document of 2018 was found (site search returns nothing, notice board lists only current items); Internet Archive offline.

508047.name: Limbach
508047.note: The documents exist but cannot be fetched by the ingest: the old website's post 'Volebné okrsky a zoznam ulíc' (https://old.limbach.sk/aktuality/volebne-okrsky-a-zoznam-ulic/, dated Nov 5, 2018, before the vote) links the scans 'Volebný okrsok č.1 ulice + kontakt' and 'Volebný okrsok č.2 ulice + kontakt' (okrsok 1: Cintorínska, Černicová, Družstevná, Gaštanová, Limbová, Malokarpatská, Mlynské pole, Pod Dúblami, Podlesná, Potočná, Priečna, Pri kockách, Raková, Silvánska, SNP, Suchý vrch, Záhradná; okrsok 2: 1. mája, Iršajská, Sadová, Slnečná, Školská, Športová, Vavrinecká, Vinohradnícka; Krátka and Limbašská dolina not named). old.limbach.sk serves a TLS certificate for another host name (the ingest's fetch fails with 'certificate verify failed'; http redirects to https), and the Internet Archive has no capture of these URLs made before the vote (no capture of limbach.sk at all from 2016–2023). Maintainer may retry with these URLs.

508071.name: Malinovo
508071.note: No okrsky document of this vote found: the municipality's elections section (malinovo.sk/samosprava/volby/) keeps pages only from the by-elections of 2021 on, and the Internet Archive's index of malinovo.sk has no capture of an elections page or okrsky notice from 2017-2020.

508098.name: Miloslavov
508098.note: The municipality's elections pages of 2017–2020 (as archived) link no okrsky document (only voter information, delegation, candidates, results). For the referendum 2026 the decision of 07.05.2026 names 5 okrsky and their polling rooms but no streets, and no street list for it was found; the okrsky cannot be drawn from it. Street lists exist for the referendum 2023, NR SR 2023 and both 2024 votes.

508110.name: Most pri Bratislave
508110.note: The municipality's elections section lists an okrsky announcement only for the NR SR election 2023; none of 2018 (the 2017 entry has only candidate lists). Internet Archive offline.

508136.name: Nová Dedinka
508136.note: The archived 2017 elections page (Voľby VÚC 2017) links no okrsky document. Every okrsky notice Nová Dedinka published (2022 municipal/regional: download_file_f.php?id=1718007, 1720353; 2024 presidential: id=1879554) only says the village has 2 okrsky, both in the Základná škola, Hlavná 45 (okrsok 1 'trieda vpravo', okrsok 2 'trieda vľavo'), with no streets or parts. 511731.note: The municipality's website (obecpodkrivan.sk; podkrivan.sk is a parked domain) publishes no okrsky document for any vote 2017-2026: its elections pages (live and archived) hold only announcements, candidate lists, voter information and results; the Internet Archive's CDX listing of ~5000 captured URLs of obecpodkrivan.sk 2017-2026 contains no 'utvorenie volebných okrskov' file. Web search found nothing either.

511927.name: Trebeľovce
511927.note: The starosta's decision of 14.8.2018 (in https://web.archive.org/web/20180905020309/http://obectrebelovce.sk/volby.pdf) sets okrsok 1 'obec Trebeľovce, vrátane časti Dolná Bába', okrsok 2 'časť obce Muľka', okrsok 3 'miestna časť Trebeľovce-Láza'. Láza is not a part or k.ú. in the address register (its houses are numbered within part Trebeľovce) and the document gives no house numbers, so okrsky 1 and 3 cannot be told apart by rules; reported not_found.

512354.name: Kláštor pod Znievom
512354.note: The municipality's website (obecklastor.sk; klastorpodznievom.sk redirects there) was a Webygroup site (oznamy.phtml) until 2021 and has been replaced; the live notice board starts in 2021. In the Internet Archive I read every archived notice (oznamy.phtml items id_info 40277-41824, June 2017 - April 2020), the archived notice listings of 2017-2020 and the Samospráva > Voľby section (only Komunálne voľby 2010 and 2014). For 2018 the site posted the decision of the NR SR speaker, information for voters, the council's one volebný obvod with 9 seats, the candidate-list notice and the candidates; no document forming the okrsky or naming their streets/parts was published or archived. The Internet Archive was intermittently offline but answered in the end.

512729.name: Turčianske Teplice
512729.note: The city's 2018 elections page (live section "Voľby do OSO 2018" of volby.html, and as archived on 2018-08-31) lists only the election decree, the population notice, the obvody notice (uznesenie 59/2018), the campaign rules and the appointment of the commission's clerk; it links no okrsky document for 2018. The Internet Archive's 2018 captures of the domain hold no other elections file (no PDF other than an unrelated one), and the notice board of 2018 is not kept live or archived after January 2018. The obvody notice puts okrsky 4 and 6 in obvod 5 without saying which addresses vote in each (later votes' documents give okrsok 4 as the Centrum sociálnych služieb Horný Turiec, Banská 19, plus residents registered only at the town, but none of 2018 survives). Web search found no 2018 document.

513253.name: Košeca
513253.note: The old website's elections pages (2018, 2019, 2020, archived in the Internet Archive) link no okrsky document, and the current website has elections pages only from 2023 on.

513296.name: Ladce
513296.note: No 2018 okrsky document found. The live 2018 elections pages are gone (the CMS returns an error) and 'Komunálne voľby 2018' shows only results. The Internet Archive's capture of 'Dokumenty pre voľby do orgánov samosprávy obcí 2018' of 2018-11-04 links 'Deň a miesto konania volieb' (PDF, page/2183) and an image den_volieb.JPG, which may have listed the okrsky, but neither is archived (404) nor still on the live site. The council's resolution 53/2018 and its minutes of 19 July 2018 name only the three obvody by area (Ladce, časť Tunežice, Horné Ladce), not the four okrsky. The Internet Archive was intermittently offline (HTTP 503 / no connection) for much of the search, so captures of other pages (úradné oznamy of autumn 2018) could not be fully checked.

513300.name: Lazy pod Makytou
513300.note: Lazy pod Makytou's website (lazypodmakytou.sk, webygroup host that rate-limits) now shows only the documents of 2026 (referendum, municipal and regional elections); no okrsky document of this vote is linked. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline) during the search.

513342.name: Lysá pod Makytou
513342.note: No okrsky document of this vote found. The live site's election pages hold okrsky documents only for NRSR 2023, prezident 2024 and EP 2024 (súpisné 1-427 / 428-1600); the referendum pages (2023, 2026) list none. Archived 2019 pages (volby, EP 2019) hold only results and the vyhlásenie; the archived prezident 2019 and referendum 2023 pages could not be fetched (Internet Archive intermittently offline).

513351.name: Košecké Podhradie
513351.note: The current website's election articles begin with the 2022 elections (the NR SR article a73-22 has no files); no okrsky document of the municipal elections of 10 November 2018 found. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us), so the older site could not be checked.

513466.name: Papradno
513466.note: No 2018 okrsky notice archived or on the website.

513598.name: Pruské
513598.note: The live site (obecpruske.sk) answered HTTP 429 throughout. The Internet Archive's copy of this vote's page lists only other documents (candidates, voter information, announcements) and no okrsky text; the okrsky text appears on the obec's pages only from the NR SR 2023 election on (the archived referendum-2023 page of 2023-07-12 already shows the NR SR 2023 text, not the referendum's). Internet Archive was intermittently offline.

513741.name: Udiča
513741.note: No okrsky decision for this vote on obecudica.sk: the current elections list starts in autumn 2022 and has none for the EP elections 2024; the archived old elections page (August 2019) lists only the announcements, candidates and results of 2018–2019. Another vote's decision is not this vote's.

513865.name: Zliechov
513865.note: Zliechov's elections documents (zliechov.sk/dokumenty/volby/, all categories: archív, komunálne, parlamentné, referendum, europarlament, VÚC, prezident) hold okrsky notices only for 2022 (Okrsky.pdf) and the NR SR election 2023; none for this vote. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline) during the search.

513911.name: Bystričany
513911.note: The website's elections section covers 2022–2024 only. Its okrsky notices (NR SR 2023 of 26.06.2023, president 2024 of 31.01.2024) give only the two polling stations (zasadačka OcÚ, Mirka Nešpora 1/17; sála KD, Dlhá 328/16), not which streets or parts vote where; with three parts and two okrsky no okrsok can be inferred from its station. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

513962.name: Diviaky nad Nitricou
513962.note: The archived 2018 elections page (https://web.archive.org/web/20220521003323/https://www.diviaky.sk/m/samosprava/volby/komunalne-volby-2018/) has only the results.

513989.name: Dolné Vestenice
513989.note: No okrsky document of the 2018 municipal elections found. The current website (rebuilt in 2025) has election pages only for 2026. The old website's "Voľby" page, archived 2017–2021, lists only results files; the archived notice board (úradná tabuľa) captures show only its category menu, and no okrsky document or page naming one is in the Internet Archive.

514063.name: Kamenec pod Vtáčnikom
514063.note: The website's election document categories hold okrsky documents only from 2022 on (for this vote at most the commissions' minutes); no okrsky document of this vote found. The Internet Archive was unreachable for over 20 minutes.

514136.name: Lehota pod Vtáčnikom
514136.note: No okrsky document for the municipal elections of 2018 found: the 2018 elections page's capture could not be fetched from the Internet Archive (refused repeatedly) and no okrsky file of 2018 is in its CDX.

514209.name: Nedožery-Brezany
514209.note: No document assigning streets or parts to the two okrsky found. The municipality's okrsky decisions on nedozery-brezany.sk (2023: images/Vytvorenie_volebnch_okrskov_a_urenie_volebnch_miestnost2023.pdf; 2026: images/Urenie_volebnch_okrskov_a_volebnej_miestnosti.pdf) only create two okrsky with both polling stations in the municipal office (Družstevná 367/1), so neither the streets nor the parts (Nedožery, Brezany) of each okrsok can be read or inferred; for the other votes the site and the Internet Archive's index of nedozery-brezany.sk hold no okrsky notice.

514225.name: Nitrianske Pravno
514225.note: The municipality's okrsky decisions found (presidential and EP elections 2024: 'Vytvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností') give each of the 4 okrsky only its polling station, not its streets; with 4 okrsky in 3 parts (okrsky 1 and 2 both in Nitrianske Pravno) the okrsky cannot be drawn. The 2019 decisions' archived file is not retrievable (the file id now serves another document); other votes' pages carry no okrsky document.

514292.name: Oslany
514292.note: The archived 2018 elections page (2018-10-12) links 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností' (Oslany-okrsky.pdf, download_file_f.php?id=1013644), but the file is gone from the website (404) and the Internet Archive never captured it.

514331.name: Pravenec
514331.note: No okrsky document of this vote found: the current website keeps election notices only from 2023 on, and the Internet Archive has no capture of the old website's notices from 2017–2022 (only its home page). Pravenec is one part (časť obce Pravenec) whose 451 addresses carry only súpisné čísla and no streets; with two okrsky, a document must say which houses vote where. The notices of 2023 and 2024 give only the two polling stations.

514349.name: Radobica
514349.note: The website's elections pages start with the 2022 elections; no okrsky document of the municipal elections of 2018 found. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

514420.name: Valaská Belá
514420.note: The website's election pages (municipal 2018, referendum 2023, referendum 2026) and the site search have no okrsky document for this vote (only decrees, voter information, candidate lists and results); pages for the presidential, EP and NR SR elections 2019-2024 and VÚC 2017 do not exist. The only okrsky document is that of 24.10.2026.

514888.name: Hrachovo
514888.note: The website's elections pages start with 2022; nothing for this vote. Internet Archive (CDX API) refused connections / 503 on retries, so archived pages could not be checked.

514900.name: Hrnčiarska Ves
514900.note: The notices (all 26 pages paged, slowly because of HTTP 429 rate limits) hold okrsky lists only for 2022 (published 17.8.2022) and the October 2026 elections (30.7.2026); nothing for this vote. The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

514926.name: Hrušovo
514926.note: Hrušovo appears to have no official website: none of the guessed domains resolve, Wikipedia/Wikidata list none, e-obce gives only an azet.sk e-mail, web searches find no municipal site, and the Internet Archive has no captures of hrusovo.sk or obechrusovo.sk. No okrsky document could be found.

515001.name: Jesenské
515001.note: The municipality's okrsky decisions on its notice board (referendum 2023 of 09.11.2022, NR SR 2023 of 23.06.2023, president 2024 of 05.02.2024, EP 2024 of 21.02.2024) only create okrsky 1 and 2 voting in the same room (Kultúrny dom / telocvičňa, Mieru) without saying which streets belong to which; no rules can be written. Nothing older than 2022 on the site; the referendum 2026 page has no okrsky document. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

515043.name: Klenovec
515043.note: No okrsky notice of 2018 on the notice board (live or archived); the elections page has only results.

515442.name: Rimavská Seč
515442.note: The 2018 municipal elections page links voter information, candidate lists and results only; no okrsky document.

515736.name: Veľké Teriakovce
515736.note: No okrsky document of the municipal elections of 10 November 2018 found: the archived 2019 'Ostatné' documents list of the site has the 2018 election documents (zapisovateľka, kandidáti, výsledky) but no okrsky decision. The municipality's live site (WordPress, rebuilt 2026) keeps only the okrsky document of the elections of 24 October 2026 (okrsok 1: Veľké Teriakovce, Malé Teriakovce, Krásna; okrsok 2: Vrbovce nad Rimavou), which is not valid for this vote. The Internet Archive (CDX of velketeriakovce.sk 2016-2026) holds okrsky announcements only for the referendum of 2023-01-21 (2022-11-10), the NRSR election of 2023-09-30 (2023-06-26), the presidential election of 2024 (2024-01-30) and the EP election of 2024 (2024-03-05).

515850.name: Veľký Krtíš
515850.note: The 2018 okrsky document exists but is lost: the city's 2018 elections page as archived on 2018-10-01 lists "Určenie volebných okrskov a volebných miestností" (download_file_f.php?id=1014816, 575.1 kB, zverejnené 7.9.2018). The live website answers 404 for that file (the old 2018 files are no longer served; the current Voľby page has no 2018 section), and the Internet Archive holds no capture of it under any form of the URL (its CDX lists other download ids of the domain for 2018-2019, not 1014816). Web search found no other copy. The council resolution 331/2018 sets only the 3 obvody, not the 12 okrsky (the 2017 VÚC okrsky document gives the same streets split into 12 okrsky, but it is another vote's).

516520.name: Vinica
516520.note: The website vinica.sk (live) has elections pages from 2024 on and the notice board archive to 2019, none with an okrsky document (only results, candidate lists, voter information). The Internet Archive (CDX of vinica.sk, 2017-2026) holds no okrsky document: its 2017-2018 captures are of the old site (May/August 2017) without elections material; the only okrsky item found is the 2023 NRSR page 'Zoznam ulíc a okrskov pre voľby do NR SR' whose DOCX (210sk_1.docx) is gone live (404) and was never archived; the referendum 2023 and 2022 pages' PDFs are gone live and not archived. No document of this vote's okrsky was found.

516759.name: Hodruša-Hámre
516759.note: No okrsky document of 2018 found. The village's front page as archived on 2018-10-06 lists the 2018 election notices (informácie pre voliča, the obvody notice of 16.8.2018, the population notice, the candidate lists), none of them on okrsky; the obvody notice and the council minutes of 9.8.2018 name the obvody (parts Banská Hodruša, Dolné Hámre, Kopanice) but no okrsky. The live site (rebuilt) has no 2018 elections section, and the Internet Archive's 2018–2019 captures hold no other 2018 election document.

516767.name: Hliník nad Hronom
516767.note: The 2018 page 'Volebné okrsky a volebné miestnosti' (posted 19.10.2018) links the PDF download_file_f.php?id=1035656, but the Internet Archive never captured that file and the live site answers 404; its content is unknown.

516970.name: Kremnica
516970.note: The city's elections page keeps okrsky decisions from the NR SR election 2023 on; no okrsky document of this vote is on the website, and the Internet Archive CDX returned nothing for the domain.

517500.name: Dlhé Pole
517500.note: The 2018 document (mayor, 06.09.2018) gives no territory. Every okrsky document of Dlhé Pole found (2018: web.archive.org/web/20181126072432/http://www.obecdlhepole.sk:80/files/7885-utvorenie-volebnych-okrskov-a-menovanie-zapisovateliek.pdf; referendum 2023: archived attachment FLXmg3JBnkQhvec3mudzPW.pdf of 10.11.2022; 2026: attachment qGu7WbfWsrbYENFepNcKyU.pdf of 15.07.2026) only creates 2 okrsky, both voting in the Kultúrny dom Dlhé Pole, and names their recorders; none assigns any territory. The village has 4 parts but 2 okrsky with one shared polling station, so not even the station-to-part inference applies.

517739.name: Lietava
517739.note: No okrsky document of the municipal elections 2018 was found: the website keeps only the 2026 votes, and the Internet Archive's captures of lietava.info (2017-2021) hold, of the elections documents, only the presidential election 2019 notice.

517895.name: Predmier
517895.note: No okrsky document found for this vote. The current website (www.predmier.sk, Civium) migrated its news only from 2022 on, with no okrsky notice (only 2022 candidate lists and results); its official notice board holds 6 recent items, none an okrsky decision. The Internet Archive's index of predmier.sk (old CMS, 2016-2020) lists no elections page or okrsky document. The municipality has no streets (houses by súpisné číslo only), so even the split of its 2 okrsky cannot be inferred.

517941.name: Rosina
517941.note: The current website (obecrosina.sk) lists only okrsok commission minutes and results for 2023–2026; the old site rosina.sk, as archived, has 2018–2019 election posts with the call of the elections and voter information but no okrsky decision; no document assigning houses to the two okrsky was found for any vote (the register has no streets, only súpisné čísla).

517984.name: Strečno
517984.note: The municipality's old WordPress site (www.strecno.sk, replaced in 2024) is gone; the new site's "Voľby a referendá" page starts with the 2022 elections. The archived page "Komunálne voľby 2018" holds only the announcement, inhabitants/seats DOCs and the e-mail address for delegating commission members; "Voľby 2018 – kandidáti" and "Ochrana osobných údajov – voľby" hold candidate lists and GDPR notices. The CDX list of the domain holds no okrsky document of 2018.

517992.name: Súľov-Hradná
517992.note: No mayor's okrsky decision for the 2018 municipal elections was published: the 2018 elections page (archived 2018-09-15 on the old site and 2019-10-19 on the new one) lists only voter information, mandate scope, number of councillors and obvody, population, e-mail address, MVK recorder, candidate lists and GDPR notice; the council resolution 10/2018 sets the obvody Súľov and Hradná but does not mention okrsky. The 2023 documents name each okrsok by its part (Súľov, Hradná). The Internet Archive was intermittently offline during the search.

518051.name: Turie
518051.note: Municipal elections 2018: the archived notice 'Komunálne voľby' (captured 2019-10-19) could not be loaded from the Internet Archive; no okrsky document of 2018 found. The live elections page and notice board of obecturie.sk keep only results, the referendum 2026 announcement and commission minutes; the only okrsky document found (download_file_f.php?id=2447752) is of the elections of 24 October 2026. In the Internet Archive no notice title mentions the okrsky' formation, and the archived election notices say only that the municipality formed 2 okrsky in the cultural house, without their súpisné čísla. The Internet Archive answered intermittently (several captures could not be fetched).

518069.name: Varín
518069.note: The website (notice board, its archive, site search for okrsky/okrskov/miestností na hlasovanie) has okrsky notices only for 2022, the 2023 referendum, NR SR 2023, EP 2024 (stations only) and October 2026; none for this vote. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

518093.name: Višňové
518093.note: No 2018 okrsky notice on the notice board. The okrsky of Višňové are formed by the voters' surnames (okrsok 1: priezviská A – Ma, okrsok 2: Me – Ž), both voting in the cultural house; they have no territory, so no address rules can be written. (as in the 2019-2026 documents)

518298.name: Dobrá Niva
518298.note: No okrsky document for this vote: the website's elections section (Voľby a referendá) has pages from 2022 on, and the pages of NR SR 2023, prezident 2024 and EP 2024 list only the decisions, voters' information, forms and commission records; the site search finds no okrsky notice. The old domain dobraniva.sk is now a parked domain with almost nothing in the Internet Archive, and the Archive's CDX query for obecdobraniva.sk timed out.

518379.name: Dúbravy
518379.note: No okrsky document for the municipal elections of 10 November 2018 found. The municipality's live 'Komunálne voľby 2018' page lists all its 2018 election documents (announcement of the vote, obvody notice of 3.8.2018, population, delegation address, candidates, results, Informácie pre voliča) but no 'utvorenie volebných okrskov'; the obvody notice names no okrsky. The site's full-text search finds okrsky notices only for later votes (2022-2026). The Internet Archive stayed offline (HTTP 503 'Temporarily Offline' / connection failures) for over 15 minutes of retries, so archived 2018 pages of dubravy.sk could not be checked.

518425.name: Hontianske Tesáre
518425.note: No 2018 okrsky document found. The old website's elections page (archived 2019-10-21 and 2022-03-02) lists for the 2018 municipal elections only the speaker's decision, the obvody notice (id=998082), the population count (id=1004541), the MVK recorder's appointment (id=1009015) and the candidate lists; no 'utvorenie volebných okrskov' notice. The Archive has no capture of the 2018 notice board, and the live website's elections and notice-board sections (current and archived records) start in 2023. Four okrsky = four obvody (Hontianske Tesáre, Báčovce, Dvorníky, Šipice) per the Statistical Office, but no 2018 document states it.

518590.name: Ľubotice
518590.note: The live website (moderneobce CMS) keeps election pages only from 2022 on. The Internet Archive's captures of lubotice.eu and obeclubotice.sk (2017–2020) hold no okrsky document with streets for this vote. The archived 2018 elections page (captures 2018-07-28, 2018-08-29) links only the announcement of the number of councillors, information for voters, the proclamation, population count and the MVK recorder; no okrsky document.

518662.name: Očová
518662.note: No document assigning streets to okrsky for this vote: ocova.sk's elections pages (Voľby a referendum: 2018, EP 2019, NRSR 2020, NRSR 2023, local 2025, referendum 2026) and the Internet Archive's captures (2019 elections pages and files) hold only general voter information, e-mail addresses, results and, for 2025 and the referendum 2026, decisions naming the three polling stations without streets; there is no page for the 2017 regional, 2019 presidential or 2024 EP elections.

518689.name: Pliešovce
518689.note: The municipality's pages for this vote show only results (and for NR SR 2023 the commission minutes); the only okrsky document on the website is the street list for the referendum of 21.01.2023. No okrsky document for this vote was found live or among the Internet Archive's captures.

518701.name: Rykynčice
518701.note: No 2018 okrsky document found. The live website (www.rykyncice.sk) refused connections throughout (about 20 minutes, ports 80 and 443). Of its 2018 files the Internet Archive keeps from the election period only the information for voters, the speaker's decision (vo__by1.pdf = Z. z. 203/2018) and the number of councillors (Po__et_poslancov.pdf); no 'utvorenie volebných okrskov' notice, and no capture of the 2018 elections page or notice board. Two okrsky = the two obvody (Horné and Dolné Rykynčice) per the Statistical Office, but no 2018 document states it.

518972.name: Zvolenská Slatina
518972.note: The 2018 municipal elections page (archived 2022-01-12) lists the candidate lists, the obvod and seats notice, the MVK clerk, etc., but no okrsky document or 'informácia o čase a mieste'. The documents of 2022–2026 give the okrsky by streets.

519197.name: Giraltovce
519197.note: The town's decisions on the okrsky (e.g. 3 September 2018, 9 November 2022 for the 2023 referendum, 4 May 2026 for the 2026 referendum) list the 3 okrsky only by number and polling station (all on Dukelská), with no streets or houses; the town has 2 parts (Giraltovce, Francovce), so the 3 okrsky cannot be drawn from them, and no street list of the okrsky was found.

520039.name: Belá nad Cirochou
520039.note: The live elections page and notice board start in 2022. The Internet Archive (CDX of belanadcirochou.sk, 2017-2024; it was offline for about 10 minutes, then answered) holds the old Webnode site, captured mostly from 2019 on; its election pages carry calls, voter information and commission notices but no okrsky document, and no archived PDF of utvorenie volebných okrskov exists for this vote.

520098.name: Čabalovce
520098.note: No official website of the village was found (cabalovce.sk and obeccabalovce.sk do not resolve; web search finds only aggregators). The village has no street names and one part, so its 2 okrsky could only be told apart by an official list of súpisné čísla, which was not found. Internet Archive offline.

520829.name: Stakčín
520829.note: The website (stakcin.eu; stakcin.sk does not resolve) publishes for each vote only 'Určenie volebnej miestnosti' (e.g. 23.6.2023 NR SR, 29.1.2024 president) giving one polling station for both okrsky č. 1 and č. 2, without streets; the obec has a single part, so the okrsky cannot be drawn. No page or document for the other votes.

521299.name: Čaňa
521299.note: The live website keeps election pages only for 2026 (referendum and the autumn 2026 elections); the notice board has no okrsky document of this vote. The Internet Archive (web.archive.org CDX API) stayed offline (HTTP 503 / connection failures) for over 20 minutes of retries with pauses, so archived pages of earlier votes could not be searched.

521493.name: Jasov
521493.note: The official website www.jasov.sk (host 46.28.107.238) refused every connection from us, and so did the Internet Archive; the old site obecjasov.sk was last updated in 2015 and has no elections documents. No document could be read; the maintainer may retry.

521523.name: Kecerovce
521523.note: All notice-board articles of the website (ids 900-1350, incl. the ones migrated from the old site) were checked: for this vote there are only information for voters, the decree calling it, delegation notices or results; no "utvorenie volebných okrskov" document. The only okrsky document is that of the elections of 24.10.2026. CUET has none.

521639.name: Kysak
521639.note: Kysak's okrsky documents (určenie volebných okrskov of 29.7.2022, 19.6.2023, 23.1.2024; the other votes' pages in the Internet Archive list none) only create okrsok 1 and 2 with their rooms and say 'Voliči budú zaradení do volebných okrskov podľa súpisného čísla' without giving which súpisné numbers go where, so no rules can be written. The only split found is the 2017 voter rolls per okrsok (Okrsok_1/2_KSK2017.pdf, names with súpisné numbers), captured only in 2025 and not naming the vote, so not datable as the 2017 document. The website itself refuses connections from here.

521671.name: Medzev
521671.note: Medzev's live website (medzev.sk, Voľby a referendá and úradná tabuľa, all pages) now shows only the documents of the elections of October 2026; the okrsky documents of earlier votes are gone. The Internet Archive, where they might be kept, refused connections (offline) during the search.

521931.name: Rozhanovce
521931.note: The website (rozhanovce.com; the old rozhanovce.sk does not resolve) keeps only notices for 2023 NR SR, 2024 and the 2026 referendum, which give the number of okrsky (2) and their rooms (Kultúrny dom, veľká / malá sála) but no streets or house numbers; both stations are in the same building, so the okrsky cannot be drawn. The live site's notice board reaches back only to 2022; the elections page (volby-komunalne, live and archived 2018-11-24) links only results; archived notice-board pages of August and October 2018 list no elections notice, and no 2018 elections notice (vyveska) or PDF is in the Internet Archive's index. The Internet Archive's CDX API was intermittently unreachable; timemaps worked.

529371.name: Bratislava-Devínska Nová Ves
529371.note: The 2018 municipal elections page was archived only in April 2019, already redirecting to the home page; the Internet Archive holds no 2018 capture of it and, of /buxus/docs/volby_2018/, only 2024 captures of two 404 files (candidates, results). The current website's elections pages start in 2022. No okrsky document of 2018 found.

529401.name: Bratislava-Devín
529401.note: devin.sk (new moderneobce site since 2023) keeps only the 2026 vote pages (referendum 4.7.2026 and municipal elections 24.10.2026, both with one okrsok); pages of earlier votes are deleted (enumerated page IDs 18200-31600: no other vote page). CUET lists no okrsky document of Devín (2023-2026 entries only). web.archive.org refused connections throughout (retried many times over ~30 min), so archived 2018-2024 documents could not be checked; IA offline.

529419.name: Bratislava-Lamač
529419.note: The district's live archive ZIP of the 2018 municipal elections (komunalne-volby-2018.zip) and the old site's 'Komunálne voľby – Rok 2018' page as archived (2018-08-05, 2019-07/08) list the information for voters, objection office, campaign notice, candidate lists, polling outside the station, results and the commission's minutes, but no okrsky document. No document of 2018 found.

529427.name: Bratislava-Záhorská Bystrica
529427.note: The archived 2018 elections page (capture 2018-10-27) lists the election documents (announcement, number of deputies, delegation address, candidates) but no okrsky decision; none is in the CDX of zahorskabystrica.sk or old.zahorskabystrica.sk. The IA was intermittently offline; the 2018 category page could not be loaded.

529443.name: Bratislava-Jarovce
529443.note: No okrsky document for the municipal elections of 10 Nov 2018 on www.jarovce.sk, live or in the Internet Archive: the CDX of jarovce.sk/dokumenty/volby/ and of the whole domain 2018–2020 lists only other election files (2018 results, nrsr2020 voter information, delegation, ballot forms), no 'určenie volebných okrskov'; archived home pages of 2018–2019 were unreachable or show no such link. The okrsky documents found start with 2022 (URCENIE OKRSKOV.pdf, naming the elections of 29. 10. 2022), which do not count for this vote. Web search found nothing either. The okrsky also changed between votes (2023 vs 2024 split differs), so a later document cannot be assumed.

542717.name: Bojná
542717.note: The website has election pages only for NR SR 2023, president 2024, EP 2024 and 2026; none holds an okrsky list for this vote (EP 2024 only says "2 volebné okrsky", one room in the Kultúrny dom). Fetched slowly because of HTTP 429 rate limits. The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

542733.name: Bošany
542733.note: The website's elections section starts with NR SR 2020; no page or document for the 2018 vote. Internet Archive (CDX API) refused connections / 503 on retries, so archived pages could not be checked.

542938.name: Horné Obdokovce
542938.note: No document of the 2018 okrsky found. The municipality's 'Komunálne voľby 2018' page (live and as archived 2019-07-31) holds only the results (posted 22.11.2018); the old site archiv.hobdokovce.sk ends in 2017; the Internet Archive has no 2018 capture of the new site's elections pages or notice board; the council minutes of 27.6.2018 (input document) set the two obvody (Horné Obdokovce, Obsolovce) but do not name or number the okrsky. Web searches found nothing.

543004.name: Chynorany
543004.note: The archived notice board (2018-07-15) lists a notice 'Voľby do orgánov samosprávy obcí - 10.11.2018', but that notice page was never archived and is gone from the live site; no capture of the notice board from August–November 2018 exists, and no okrsky PDF of 2018 is archived. The website www.chynorany.sk (Webygroup) keeps no election pages of earlier votes today (only 'Voľby 2026' for the October 2026 elections, with no okrsky document); its notice board and notice archive hold no okrsky document. The Internet Archive (CDX of chynorany.sk, all URLs 2017–2026) was searched for election pages, notice-board captures and the archived PDFs near each vote. Web search with the input queries found nothing either. The Internet Archive was reachable (its CDX API timed out at first, then answered).

543187.name: Jaklovce
543187.note: The 2018 elections page (live and archived 2021) lists no documents; nothing of 2018 in the CDX. The 2022 document (19.7.2022) is of a later vote.

543322.name: Margecany
543322.note: Margecany's okrsky decisions found (prezident 2024: 23.1.2024; referendum 2026: 24.4.2026) only create okrsky č. 1 and č. 2 and name their polling rooms (rooms 102 and 109 in the same obecný úrad building); they assign no streets, houses or parts to either okrsok, and the municipality has a single part, so no rules can be written or inferred. The live elections pages for 2017-2020 are empty and no other okrsky document of 2017-2026 is on the live site. The Internet Archive was offline (Temporarily Offline / empty CDX) throughout repeated retries over ~15 minutes, so archived pages could not be checked.

543331.name: Markušovce
543331.note: The website's elections section has pages only for NR SR 2020/2023, municipal 2018/2022, prezident 2024 and EP 2024; the 2018 page has no files. The Internet Archive was unreachable when checked.

543373.name: Nálepkovo
543373.note: The website's okrsky notices (referendum 2023 of 10.11.2022, president 29.1.2024, EP 5.3.2024) only create two okrsky voting in one room (zasadacia miestnosť OcÚ) without saying which addresses vote in which; no rules can be written from them. The board and elections pages go back only to 2022. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

543519.name: Rudňany
543519.note: No document assigning houses to the two okrsky found. The municipality's okrsky decisions (rudnany.sk, Voľby: referendum 2023, NRSR 2023, presidential and EP 2024) only name the two polling stations (ZŠ s. č. 96; obecný úrad s. č. 234); the pages of 2018-2020 and of the referendum 2026 carry no okrsky notice. The municipality has no streets (houses by súpisné číslo in one part), so the split cannot be inferred.

543535.name: Slovinky
543535.note: The only okrsky decision found (EP 2024, 05.03.2024) names the two okrsky's polling rooms (Kultúrny dom Slovinky 58, Komunitné centrum Slovinky 379) without saying which houses vote where; the municipality is one part with no streets, so the okrsky cannot be drawn. Other votes' pages carry no okrsky document; the Internet Archive has no captures of obecslovinky.sk.

543578.name: Spišské Podhradie
543578.note: No okrsky document for the municipal elections of 2018: the website's notice board and search have no 2018 election notice, and the Internet Archive's CDX of spisskepodhradie.sk has none.

543624.name: Spišský Štvrtok
543624.note: No okrsky notice of this vote found: the municipality's notice board (spisskystvrtok.sk) and the Internet Archive's index of the site have okrsky notices only from November 2022 on (referendum 2023, NRSR 2023, presidential and EP 2024, referendum 2026); the archived elections pages of 2019-2020 carry no okrsky document.

543772.name: Somotor
543772.note: No document of the 2018 okrsky found. The municipality's 'Voľby 2018' documents (re-posted 29.01.2025) hold the obvody announcement (one obvod per part: Somotor, Véč, Nová Vieska pri Bodrogu), voter information, the appointment of the MVK recorder, candidates and results, but no decision on the okrsky and polling stations; none numbers the okrsky. The okrsky decision found for the presidential election of 2019 (25.1.2019) is another vote's. The Internet Archive's CDX stayed offline (503/504, 'Temporarily Offline') for obecsomotor.sk and somotor.sk on repeated tries over about 15 minutes. Web searches found nothing.

543802.name: Streda nad Bodrogom
543802.note: The municipality's okrsky decisions (EP 2019, 22.02.2019; 2022; referendum 2023, 09.11.2022) only name the two okrsky's seats (Hlavná 390/176 or 391/174, and the cultural house Hlavná 217/127) without saying which streets or houses vote where; the okrsky cannot be drawn from them. Other votes' pages carry no okrsky document.

543951.name: Vojčice
543951.note: The live website (obecvojcice.sk) keeps only the 2026 election pages and a short notice board; neither has an okrsky announcement (the 2026 'Oznámenie o čase a mieste konania volieb' names only the polling station Kultúrny dom - svadobka and the okrsok number, no streets). Older pages are gone, and the Internet Archive stayed offline for this domain (CDX queries answered 'Temporarily Offline' / 504 on repeated attempts over about an hour), so no earlier document could be looked up. Web search found nothing.

544001.name: Zemplínska Nová Ves
544001.note: No 2018 okrsky document found. The live site lists elections only from 2022 on and its notice-board archive starts in 2021. The Internet Archive keeps the 2018 site (homepage 2018-08-31, notices of September 2018 such as the e-mail address for commission delegations and the candidate list, and every PDF of /files/2018-*), but none of them is the mayor's utvorenie volebných okrskov for 10 November 2018; the elections page /-volby as archived in 2019 holds only 2019 files. The council minutes of 2.8.2018 (scan, OCR) and resolution 22/2018 set only the two obvody (Úpor 4 seats, Zemplínsky Klečenov 3 seats) and do not mention okrsky. Okrsky documents exist only from 2023 on (files/2023-01-11-…, 2024-01-18-… Určenie volebných okrskov a volebných miestností). Web search found nothing else.

544094.name: Bystré
544094.note: Searched the municipality's website obecbystre.sk (elections page, aktuality all 35 pages, notice board, archives) and its predecessor bystre.ocu.sk, live and in the Internet Archive (CDX of both domains; downloaded and viewed every archived/live file of the election period). No 2018 okrsky document was found live or archived (no election article of summer 2018 was captured; the files of July–November 2018 are other matters). Moreover, every okrsky notice Bystré has published (2023–2026) names only the two polling stations (Obecný úrad, Šarišská 98/20; Komunitné centrum, Hamzova 630/2A or Kultúrny dom, Poštová 306/8), no streets; with a single part (Bystré) and both stations in it, such a document could not give rules either. The Internet Archive was slow/intermittent but answered after retries.

544116.name: Čaklov
544116.note: The elections page keeps only commission minutes (NRSR 2023, presidential and EP 2024, referendum 2026); the notice board's only okrsky notice ('Oznámenie o vytvorení volebných okrskov a určení volebných miestností', detail=74892) is of the 2026 municipal elections. No okrsky document of this vote; the Internet Archive was offline ('Temporarily Offline') during the search.

544213.name: Hanušovce nad Topľou
544213.note: The city's current website lists election sections only from the 2020 National Council election on; no okrsky document of this vote is on the live website. The Internet Archive stayed offline ('Temporarily Offline' / no answer) across repeated retries over more than 15 minutes, so the city's former website (e_download.php files) could not be checked in the archive.

545686.name: Melčice-Lieskové
545686.note: The 2018 elections page of Melčice-Lieskové links an 'Oznámenie' of 30.7.2018 (download.php?file=f9b4983c|889, scan) giving only the count (3 okrsky) and their polling stations (obecný úrad č. 119 – okrsok 1, spoločenská miestnosť Dolina – okrsok 2, budova 'Svadobka' – okrsok 3), with no streets, parts or house numbers. The register has only 2 parts (Melčice, Zemianske Lieskové; Dolina lies within Melčice), so the okrsky cannot be given parts by their stations; no other 2018 document lists their extent. Internet Archive offline.

545741.name: Trenčianske Stankovce
545741.note: The current website's elections pages cover only 2022-2026; the notice board's archive records (searched for okrsk, volebn, voľb, miestnost, utvoren and listed in full) have for this vote only other election notices (vyhlásenie, informácie pre voliča, delegovanie, výsledky), no okrsky document; the Internet Archive holds no elections page or okrsky document of the domain from 2018.

555576.name: Trhová Hradská
555576.note: The municipality's website (live and as archived since 2017) publishes for the votes only commission minutes, delegation addresses and voter information; no document creating the okrsky (utvorenie volebných okrskov / zoznam ulíc) for any vote 2017–2026 was found; a web search found none either.

555754.name: Matúškovo
555754.note: Matúškovo's okrsky documents (2023 NR SR 'Zverejnenie volebných okrskov a volebných miestností' of 27.06.2023, and the same for 2024 and 2026) give each okrsok only its polling station, both in the same building (Centrum voľného času, Matúškovo č. 513: okrsok 1 predsieň, okrsok 2 zasadačka); the municipality has one part and no streets in the register, so no rules can be derived from them (prompt: stations only and not one per part -> not_found). No document assigning streets or house numbers to the okrsky was found on the website, live or in the Internet Archive's CDX of matuskovo.sk 2017-2026.

555878.name: Horná Kráľová
555878.note: No okrsky document of the 2018 municipal elections on hornakralova.sk: the media library (searched for okrsk/volebn) and the posts of June 2018–2020 hold none, the elections page starts with 2022, and the Internet Archive has no 2018 elections page or okrsky PDF.

556157.name: Jacovce
556157.note: The 2018 elections page was archived only on 2018-07-11 (docs/volby2018/01-04: obvody/poslanci, počet obyvateľov, informácia, vyhlásenie); no okrsky document of 2018 is archived; the old /docs/ paths answer 404 on the new site.

556483.name: Križovany nad Dudváhom
556483.note: The 2018 elections page (archived and live) links the decision, voter information, the population count, the obvod/seats announcement, candidate lists and results; no okrsky document. Archived notice-board scans of July–August 2018 were OCR-checked: contracts only.

557293.name: Vlkanová
557293.note: The 2018 'Určenie volebného okrsku, volebnej miestnosti a zapisovateľa' (10.09.2018, archived) names okrsky 1 and 2 with the same polling room (Spoločenská sála Obecného úradu) and no streets; the municipality has one part, so no rules can be derived.

557358.name: Vrútky
557358.note: No okrsky document of this vote found: the town's current website (vrutky.sk) keeps vote pages only from the 2022 elections on, and the Internet Archive's sparse captures of the old site (2016-2021, textsvk/ and download/ files) hold only 2018 election results, no okrsky notice.

558320.name: Ivanka pri Nitre
558320.note: No 2018 document: the archived old site (2017–2018) holds no elections page or okrsky file. The only okrsky documents on ivankaprinitre.sk are of 2022-11 (referendum 2023), 2023-06 (NR SR 2023), 2024-01 (president 2024), 2024-03 (EP 2024), giving only the three polling stations (all in the Kultúrny dom), and 2026-07 (municipal/regional 2026-10-24, with streets). Internet Archive was reachable.

559784.name: Turňa nad Bodvou
559784.note: No okrsky decision for this vote on the website's notice board (which keeps the 2022, 2022-11 referendum, 2024 presidential and 2026 decisions) or in the Internet Archive: the archived 2018–2020 election pages list only voter information and candidate lists (their 2018 'oznam' PDFs are 404 and not archived), and no decision for 2017, 2019, 2023-09, 2024-06 or the 2026 referendum is published.

580317.name: Utekáč
580317.note: The elections page links only 'Oznamenie_okrsky.pdf', which states that the obec has 2 okrsky and gives each only its polling station (č. 1 Utekáč 848 sála MKS; č. 2 Utekáč – Drahová 1051), no streets or parts. The register has a single part (Utekáč), so the okrsky cannot be assigned by part; no document defines which addresses vote where. The Internet Archive (offline at first, reachable later) holds for obecutekac.sk in 2017 only captures of older election pages (NR SR 2016, municipal 2014) and no okrsky document.

580554.name: Čenkovce
580554.note: The website's elections page lists only the 2026 referendum article, whose files (results, information for voters, decision on the referendum) include no okrsky document; older votes are not on the current site. The site then refused our connections (blocked) and the Internet Archive refused connections too, so the notice board and older captures could not be checked; the maintainer may retry.

580899.name: Lužianky
580899.note: The obec's current site keeps for the municipal elections of 2018 only the results ('Komunálne voľby 2018', posted 1.12.2018). The 2018 site (Joomla) has only a few captures in the Internet Archive (May 2018, none of the notice board or an elections page in summer–autumn 2018) and no okrsky document of 2018 in the CDX listing of the domain.

581020.name: Hrnčiarovce nad Parnou
581020.note: The archived 2018 elections page (komunalne-volby-2018.html, captured 2018-11-16) lists the candidates, the voter information and the notice on obvody and council seats, but no okrsky document; the municipality has one part and its later decisions (2022-2026) only name one polling station, Kultúrny dom, Farská 37, for every okrsok, without streets.

581399.name: Banka
581399.note: The notice board (current and archive) and the site search find okrsky documents only for the 2022 elections and the 2023 referendum; no okrsky document of the municipal elections of 2018 found. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

582816.name: Žitavany
582816.note: The live website (www.zitavany.sk, Voľby - Referendum) keeps vote pages only from the 2022 elections on; the oldest okrsky document there is the referendum's of 2023. In the Internet Archive (CDX of zitavany.sk 2017–2022 and of the old notice board) no okrsky document of 2017–2020 is captured: the 'Voľby VÚC 2017' page is captured empty (2018-12-30, 2021-05-06); the 2018 notice-board entry 'Voľby do orgánov samosprávy obcí 2018' links only the voters' information and the decision calling the elections; the 2018 obvody notice concerns council obvody only; the 2019 notice board lists EP 2019 voter-information and voting-certificate entries, never captured, and no okrsky entry; the 2020 by-election page links only the obvody/seats decision and results. Web search found nothing else. The Archive was intermittently offline but answered after retries.

599794.name: Košice-Krásna
599794.note: The website's elections page starts with the 2022 elections and the old notice board (to 8/2021) holds nothing on elections; no okrsky document of the municipal elections of 10 November 2018 found. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

599972.name: Košice-Luník IX
599972.note: The live website www.mclunik9.sk refused connections on 2026-10-31. In the Internet Archive, the old site's notice board (uradna_elektronicka_tabula, captured 2019-07-16, listing every item from 2015 to 26.3.2019) and the WordPress board that replaced it in 2020 (oznamenia, captured 2020-10-28; elections page dokumenty/volby empty) list no 'utvorenie volebných okrskov' for any vote before 2022: for the municipal elections of 2018 they post only the obvod and council size notice (16.08.2018), the population count, the commission e-mail address, the registrar, the candidate lists and the results (volby_2018.pdf, a results zápisnica). The archive's list of the domain's PDFs has no okrsky document before the 2022 one (Utvorenie-volebnych-okrskov-a-urcenie-volebnej-miestnosti-v-MC-KE-LIX.pdf, dated 3.8.2022), which may not be used for this vote.
